SELECT m.id,CASE WHEN m.kind='PAGE' THEN pp.title WHEN m.kind='CATEGORY' THEN c.name ELSE m.label END AS label, m.kind,pp.page_id,pp.slug,c.id AS category_id,CASE WHEN m.kind='LINK' THEN m.url ELSE NULL END AS url, CASE WHEN m.kind='PAGE' THEN '/api/public/v1/pages/' || CAST(pp.page_id AS VARCHAR) WHEN m.kind='CATEGORY' THEN '/api/public/v1/posts?categoryId=' || CAST(c.id AS VARCHAR) ELSE NULL END AS api_href FROM site_menus m LEFT JOIN site_pages p ON m.kind='PAGE' AND p.id=m.target_id LEFT JOIN page_publications pp ON pp.page_id=p.id LEFT JOIN categories c ON m.kind='CATEGORY' AND c.id=m.target_id WHERE m.visible=TRUE AND ((m.kind='PAGE' AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND pp.page_id IS NOT NULL) OR (m.kind='CATEGORY' AND c.id IS NOT NULL) OR m.kind='LINK') ORDER BY m.sort_order,m.id
WHERE m.id=#{value}
